description: This file contains shell script functions related to filesystem checking utilities, specifically wrapping around 'e2fsck' for ext2, ext3, and ext4 filesystem types. It manages filesystem consistency checks and logs their statuses.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Performs filesystem check on a device using e2fsck, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper for fsck_e2fsck to check ext2 filesystems.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper for fsck_e2fsck to check ext3 filesystems.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper for fsck_e2fsck to check ext4 filesystems.
